sources.supabase_dashboard: Database > Query Performance / Performance Advisor / Index Advisor

checks.action: Use this dry-run bundle for the next live Supabase Dashboard review.
Keep the diagnostic bundle aligned with Supabase pg_stat_statements and index review needs.
Run Query Performance, Performance Advisor, and Index Advisor review before any production index migration.
checks.evidence: manual dashboard confirmation required; no production credentials stored in this artifact

checks.action: Use forward migrations, staging verification, and CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY where applicable.
checks.evidence: direct production DDL is disallowed by project operating rules

dashboard_checklist.action: Open Supabase Dashboard > Database > Query Performance and sort by total time, mean time, and calls.
dashboard_checklist.decision: Map the top slow queries to API route or UI operation before changing indexes.

dashboard_checklist.action: Open Database > Performance Advisor and rerun checks after fixes.
dashboard_checklist.decision: Create a GitHub Issue for every warning that affects production reads, writes, locks, or bloat.

dashboard_checklist.action: For each slow query, open the Indexes tab and compare suggested indexes with existing indexes.
dashboard_checklist.decision: Accept only recommendations backed by EXPLAIN evidence and expected production query shape.

dashboard_checklist.action: Run supabase inspect db outliers, index-usage, unused-indexes, seq-scans, cache-hit, locks, and blocking.
dashboard_checklist.decision: Use the CLI output to validate Dashboard findings and avoid one-off UI-only decisions.

dashboard_checklist.action: Record accepted DDL as a forward migration and prefer CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY for production-sized tables.
dashboard_checklist.decision: Never apply index DDL directly in production without WBS, Issue, rollback note, and staging evidence.

tuning_rules: Do not add or drop indexes from a single slow-query observation.
Prefer measured query plans from staging and production-like data volume.
Create or update a GitHub Issue before accepted DDL work.
Write accepted index DDL as a forward migration and include rollback notes.
Review unused indexes across at least two reporting cycles before dropping them.
